PIAS

PIAS supports naval-architecture calculations, hull modelling and ship-design documentation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model hull compartments

Start from the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended PIAS preview, model hull compartments; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Run stability calculations

Begin with the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended PIAS preview, run stability calculations; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare naval-architecture reports

Use the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended PIAS preview, prepare naval-architecture reports; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
